column1: # How to re-obtain the git-ignored files that tools/sources_sync.py has no built-in rule for (it covers eBL chapters and
# fragments, SEAL pages, CDLI photos, ORACC zips and their members). One row per file, or per folder (path ending in /).
# kinds: url | archive-org (source = item id) | unzip (source = the zip) | pdftotext / pdftotext-pages (source = the PDF,
# same folder) | manual (a person must do it; the note says how) | adhoc (made by hand; not re-made by the tool).
# tiers: work (needed for translating) | archive (not needed). After editing: python3 -I tools/sources_sync.py snapshot
